items.label: Features
items.value: Dokotoo womens sweaters tops feature with 3/4 Sleeve, Color Block, Striped, Crewneck, Oversized Fit, Drop Shoulder, Lightweight Soft Knitted Sweater, Loose Relaxed Fit Tops, Casual and fashion style fits for any body shape, and a sweater necessary for women wardrobe.

items.label: Design
items.value: Stand out with a modern oversized fit, featuring a chic color block and horizontal striped pattern. The classic crewneck and drop shoulder details give this sweater a relaxed yet stylish vibe, giving your wardrobe a fresh and trendy update.

items.label: Material
items.value: Our striped color block sweater is crafted from premium quality, lightweight, breathable materials to keep you cool and comfortable through every season. The soft knit fabric is gentle against your skin and easy to care for—simply machine wash cold and tumble dry low for hassle-free maintenance.

items.label: Match
items.value: Lightweight knit 3/4 length sleeve womens tops are easy to pair with jeans, denim shorts, leggings, tank tops, jackets, sneakers or heels to complete casual look. It pairs almost everything in your wardrobe, save you a lot time on making decisions.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Oversized sweaters for women is perfect choice for casual daily life, party, school, vacation, holiday, resort wear, cruise outfits, beach, office, work, lounging at home, date, shopping, outdoor and any other occasions. Its soft and comfort make it a top pick for spring, summer, and fall outfits for women.
